summary: Elevator malfunction at the Mollie Kathleen Gold Mine tour near Cripple Creek around noon; the tour guide was killed and four others injured in the initial incident ~500 ft down; 11 were evacuated earlier in the day while 12 adults remained trapped ~1,000 ft underground for about 6 hours until the elevator was repaired, all rescued Thursday evening
location: Mollie Kathleen Gold Mine, near Cripple Creek
responding_agency: Teller County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Springs Fire Department; Colorado Division of Reclamation, Mining and Safety mine rescue team
notes: Thursday-verified 2024-10-10; fire/EMS technical rescue rather than a SAR-team mission — notable mission with public reporting, scope-fit; 23 = 11 evacuated earlier (incl. the deceased) + 12 trapped and rescued
